elijah.name: Elijah
elijah.title: Elijah (Ilyas)
elijah.dict: One of the messengers: he asks his people, "Do you call on Baal, and forsake the Best of creators?" (37:123-132). Also named among the upright (6:85).

elisha.name: Elisha
elisha.title: Elisha (al-Yasa)
elisha.dict: Named twice in lists of those God favored (6:86, 38:48), with nothing told of him. (At 6:86 Talal Itani's translation prints "Elijah"; the Arabic has al-Yasa, Elisha.)
